products.name: FLOWER GARAETTEOK
products.description:
HAEGEUMDANG Flower Garaetteok

HAEGEUMDANG Flower Garaetteok is a versatile frozen Korean rice cake made with Korean-grown rice and sea salt. Certified vegan by The Vegan Society in the United Kingdom, it is suitable for vegan and plant-based menus. Its mild flavor and soft, chewy texture make it adaptable as either a main ingredient or a complementary ingredient in cuisines around the world.

Flower Garaetteok pairs well with a wide variety of sauces, broths, and seasonings. Beyond traditional Korean dishes, it can be incorporated into Italian-style pasta and risotto, Japanese hot pots and curry, Chinese stir-fries and hot pots, and Western-style soups, stews, and casseroles. It also adds a distinctive touch to grilled dishes, skewers, and salads.

Inspired by traditional Korean floral patterns, its signature Flower-Shaped Through-Hole Structure features seven openings running along the length of the rice cake. These openings help heat reach the interior evenly and allow sauces and broths to flow through, enhancing flavor and adding visual appeal.

Manufactured in a HACCP-certified facility, Flower Garaetteok offers overseas buyers a versatile ingredient for locally adapted menus, fusion cuisine, vegan dishes, and meal-kit development. It is supplied frozen, with a shelf life of 12 months when stored at −18°C or below.
